newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close lower, await USDA report.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close lower, await USDA report.

text.p: NYCE November frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled lower, continuing this week's see-saw pattern of trade ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's key estimate of the Florida crop, market sources said.

They expect the USDA to raise output from last year's final crop estimate of 203.2 million 90-lb boxes, to between 215 million and 225 million boxes. The USDA will release its estimate Friday at 0830 EDT.

Florida's citrus crop escaped the wrath of Josephine, a tropical storm that pummelled much of the state Tuesday. While the state said it will seek federal government disaster aid, the citrus industry was left mostly unharmed.
Light local selling pressured the spot-November contract to 112.90 on the close, down 3.35. The back months finished 1.30 to 0.75 lower.
